name: lazyfinder-sidebar-mode-40
criterio: order 2026-10-13-07 point G: --sidebar is a first-class mode: tabs Files/Search/Git, the project name in capitals, git letters at the right and the branch at the bottom, at 40 columns
cmd: cd "${TUIQA_HOME}/proj" && export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null && g() { git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false "$@"; } && g init -q -b trunk . && g add . && g commit -q -m init && echo changed >> notes.txt && echo x > loose.txt && exec "${LAZYFINDER_BIN}" --sidebar

steps.desc: the three tabs are on the first row
the project name is in capitals
the branch is at the bottom
a modified file has its letter at the right
the Git tab keeps only the changed files
the Files tab brings everything back
the shortcut to leave the mode is in the bottom bar
